title: First-Output Discrepancy and Sharp-Null Test Size for Zero-Burn-In Pair-Switching Rerandomization
banked_reason: D0.5 field-floor triage: paper_score_ceiling 6.4 < 7.4; the published accepted-move results remain one-sided liminf bounds, and exact output/size limits require a new research program.
gap_reasons: paper_score_ceiling 6.4 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'incremental'
neither an exact output-law limit nor an exact size limit
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived separate laws for the published accepted-move-only algorithm and a regularized lazy transition-then-check kernel, including fixed-dimensional entrance bounds, sharp-null size consequences, positive-score two-cap obstructions, lumping, residual certificates, and replay-test repair. The field claim collapsed because the published-rule results remained one-sided liminf bounds; exact output and size limits require new control of the accepted-move harmonic/output law. A Zhu–Liu closest-work comparison, executable implementation audit, and scalable finite-design certificate also remain unfinished.
tldr: Published PSRSRR Algorithm 3 checks only accepted unregularized moves. For arbitrary fixed-dimensional, low-leverage balanced designs with every finite-design Mahalanobis score positive and a faithful entrance-shell rate, its unconditional first-output discrepancy has limit inferior at least \(1-p_a\); in one covariate, a uniform-calibrated sharp-null Fisher test has size limit inferior at least \(1-p_a\). An exact-zero two-cap sequence has finite-design nontermination and conditional output discrepancy tending to \(1/9\); its positive-score perturbation terminates almost surely and has unconditional discrepancy limit inferior at least \(1/9\). The separate regularized lazy transition-then-check branch has exact fixed-dimensional TV and sharp-null size limits and an exact two-cap \(1/9\) limit despite a vanishing stationary-hazard-to-gap ratio.
gap: The practical on-the-fly PSRSRR rule has no verified arbitrary-start first-output theorem at zero burn-in and every-transition checks. Stationary correction identifies the invariant accepted law, not the first draw from complete randomization.
fill: Establish the exact finite killed-chain decomposition, a fixed-dimensional entrance-boundary TV limit, its one-covariate sharp-null consequence, and a growing-dimensional two-cap obstruction to global-summary heuristics. Supply carefully scoped soft-killing and count-orbit certificates.
